offering_description.value: Provides broadband internet, voice telephone, video and business communications services to residential and business customers in rural Minnesota communities. It builds and operates its own fiber and network infrastructure and bills customers on recurring monthly plans.

primary_products.value: broadband internet; voice telephone lines; video service; business phone systems

primary_services.value: network installation and maintenance; managed IT services; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households in its rural service area; B2B: local businesses, schools and healthcare providers in its service area

end_markets.value: telecommunications; residential consumers; small business; education; healthcare

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly broadband, voice and video plans; service fees: installation, managed IT and technical support; product sales: customer premises equipment and business phone systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells connectivity and communications services to households and businesses; asset operator: owns and runs its local fiber and telephone network

geography_served.value: US regional: rural communities in central and southwestern Minnesota

specialization.value: related lines: broadband, voice, video and business communications and IT services sharing the same network and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales staff for business and residential accounts; own locations: company retail and service offices in its communities; online: online ordering and account management

regulatory_exposure.value: high: incumbent local telephone service regulated by the FCC and the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission

notes: Service territory and exact product mix are from general knowledge and may be incomplete or out of date.
